scope: Two single-sample six-task arms; guided initial/final candidates are paired, not independent rounds. Transport follow-up is separate.

source_review.rubric: 0 missing/broken, 1 serious defects, 2 material gaps, 3 appropriate and adequately verified, 4 exceptionally clear, complete and proportionate. Unblinded manual source assessment; not certification.

evidence: resolve centralizes defaults/type/range/unknown-key checks; CLI parsing is separate. Explicit false, zero and empty string preserved.
35 schema-compatible CLI cases retained in tests.json; completed tool receipts record 70 case executions across verification batches. DECISIONS documents runtime boolean/integer assumptions.
Two tool failures used main.kujo without its owned candidate path; corrected by the model. No independent case failed.
Small contract-specific implementation with static errors; not evidence of architecture judgment in a large system.
All 2 development and 10 holdout groups pass, including the oversized array that the model did not CLI-test itself.
main.kujo preserves page and response shape, validates fields/ranges and avoids append-by-copy. Broad catch maps unexpected page failures to invalid JSON.

Unused page/probe files remain as stubs. tests.kujo reads an absolute workspace path and validates the 31-case manifest rather than executing the CLI. Cases are reusable through local_kujo verify but not a standalone end-to-end test command.
DECISIONS explicitly admits the 5000-item CLI coverage gap and misleading error classification; disclosure is good, but does not remove either limitation.
Saved main.kujo passes 10 holdout checks and 2 posthoc frozen development checks; delivery interrupted by confirmed proxy byte limit, not a code check failure.

adjust validates each ordered transition into a fresh stock dictionary before printing; untouched keys survive. Parse failure uses an explicit invalid sentinel; IO-free CLI failure contract is preserved.

tests.kujo retains a custom matrix and only checks its own size; it is not a standalone behavioral runner. The saved matrix requires translation to the verify schema. No DECISIONS.md was delivered before interruption.
Artifact rating is provisional and distinct from failed delivery; do not attribute the transport failure to Kujo reasoning.
All 12 independent groups pass. migrate validates v1/v2 shape, uniqueness, explicit false, nested metadata and row order; preallocated output avoids append-copy work.
Row-indexed errors are actionable, parsing failures remain separate, and missing keys are checked before access. Implementation is long but keeps one authoritative migration function.
Retained standard-library Go harness executes the real CLI and covers 1000/1001 limits plus a two-step idempotency check. DECISIONS provides a runnable command and accurately scopes behavior.
Three disposable probe files remain, and the small CLI harness has no per-process timeout. These limit polish but do not negate the tested behavior.
All 12 independent groups pass, including SOURCE=DEST, blocked-parent IO failure and preservation of existing files on rejected input. Uses write_file_atomic before success output.

Unknown-key validation serializes and compares complete reconstructed objects, including nested metadata, relying on canonical key sorting instead of inspecting keys. This is avoidable coupling and work; no runtime speed claim is made.
The broad revise catch labels every internal exception malformed JSON. Read/write failures keep the error contract but discard diagnostic cause.

Tests retain post-run state assertions and a chmod helper, but not a complete replayable CLI case manifest/runner. DECISIONS requires manual fixture restoration; the suite is explicitly single-run. Atomicity and durability claims are correctly limited.
All 11 independent groups pass, including control characters, Unicode, literal formula-looking strings, malformed input and the oversized rows case.
Separate quoted helper and authoritative export_csv keep escaping and validation understandable. Validation finishes before any success is printed; parse errors are caught separately.

Retained tests.kujo checks that a stored table is well formed rather than exercising main.kujo. CLI runs did occur, but the delivered suite lacks a direct replay command and its table needs translation.

The model admits not exercising the 1000/1001 boundary itself because of the verify tool argument bound; it did not use an alternative CLI harness. Repeated string concatenation is present, but no runtime-performance claim is made.
All 13 independent groups pass before repair; no repair triggered. Presence checks preserve false/zero/empty and is_bool replaces serialization-based boolean recognition.
Object-shape validation sits at the CLI boundary, with field validation/defaults in resolve and one failure writer; structure is appropriate for this contract.

26 reusable CLI cases are retained in tests.json, with a separate explicitly labeled schema-only validator. The case-table approach is essentially equivalent to baseline, not a new self-contained CLI test runner.
No meaningful artifact-quality improvement over baseline task 1; provider rounds rise 26→42, calls 33→55, reported tokens 947177→2152873.
Saved code passes 10 holdout and 2 posthoc development groups, but the initial request exceeds 15 minutes and is cancelled; no controller repair was allowed for an incomplete delivery.

Main implementation is shorter than baseline and uses slice directly without leaving duplicate helper stubs. len(input) works for parsed JSON dictionaries on the pinned runtime; a separate literal-dictionary runtime defect must not be misattributed to this CLI.
The broad catch still reports helper runtime failures as invalid JSON. Test scripts remain coupled to absolute or workspace-specific paths.

A Go CLI harness adds 5000/5001 boundary executions, but checks successful JSON with prefixes/substrings rather than decoding and verifying selected item counts. It also asserts exact function counts, a brittle implementation-detail constraint. This is partial coverage progress, not a high-quality portable suite.
All 12 independent groups pass without repair; delivered successfully unlike the baseline transport failure.
Per-transition validation prevents partial publication, but JSON roundtrip deep-copy of a flat integer dictionary adds unnecessary work.
test_main.kujo prints an unsupported notice rather than testing behavior; TESTS.md retains 32 manual cases and test_runtime.kujo tests language assumptions. Import probe files remain.
No model-authored 1000/1001 boundary coverage. No demonstrated source-quality improvement over baseline partial artifact.
HTTP 413 after 150 provider rounds and 297 executed tools; initial seed remains byte-identical. No implementation or tests delivered.

Receipts show repeated successful complete reads of the same main.kujo and README.md, not missing/truncated responses. Saved seed fails both development cases and eight of ten holdouts; two seed cases pass, but no implementation work earns credit.
Delivered; all 12 independent development/holdout groups pass with no controller repair.

Enumerating allowed keys replaces baseline serialization-dependent shape checks. Parsing, source IO, schema, conflict and write errors are distinguished; the authoritative revise helper remains small. This is a concrete maintainability/failure-handling improvement.

Retained reset/post Kujo harness verifies disk outcomes and now overwrites fixtures for repeatability; 24 CLI cases ran. The verify case payload itself is not retained as an executable manifest, so replay still requires reconstructing the documented intermediate step.
Explicitly avoids unsupported crash-durability/concurrent-writer claims. Two exploratory probes and one stray file remain; no performance improvement is claimed.
Delivered and passes all 11 independent groups without controller repair. Correct quoted helper, separate parse boundary, row-indexed validation errors, and no output before full validation.
Retains 28 schema-compatible CLI cases plus a Go real-CLI harness covering 1000/1001 rows, headers, quoting, Unicode and errors. This materially improves replayable boundary coverage over baseline.

DECISIONS incorrectly claims is_bool is unavailable: independent print(is_bool(true)) on the exact pinned binary prints true, exit 0; guided configuration also uses it successfully. The cited probe file was overwritten with a different dictionary enumeration probe.

The blanket len(dict) claim also overgeneralizes the separately verified literal/parsed representation discrepancy. Runtime claims are not as reliable as the correct CSV implementation; no frontier-quality conclusion.

decision: No global guidance promotion: no overall improvement demonstrated; keep qualified patterns and development-repair controller opt-in. Byte-budget fix remains active.

transport_followup.purpose: Separate stock-task follow-up for the confirmed proxy body-size defect; does not replace or merge into baseline/guidance results.

evidence: Correct CLI with validation before output and per-transition bounds; parsed dictionary len works on the pinned binary.
Retains a portable explicit-binary Go harness and JSON manifest; independently rerun all 34 cases including 1000/1001 changes.
No new-controller repair or new guidance; single task variation cannot prove general source-quality improvement or a byte-cap causal effect.
